title: Autopilot
intro: AIDOL draws the full-body front with your Codex, Design QA picks the best image from each batch and adopts it for you, then each angle you chose is drawn from the front one at a time. Anything you don't like can be swapped back or redrawn later in the side-by-side view.
introFaces: AIDOL draws each missing expression from the main illustration's front with your Codex, and Design QA picks the best image from each batch and adopts it for you. Anything you don't like can be redrawn later in the expression sheet.

phase.split: Waiting for the screen to crop the front
phase.detecting: Waiting for AI to find the angles

outcome.done: All done. Check the side-by-side view — any angle you don't like can be swapped back or redrawn.
outcome.stopped: Stopped. Resume picks up where it left off.
outcome.interrupted: AIDOL restarted, so autopilot was interrupted. Resume to continue.
outcome.needsYou: {{view}} was redrawn a few times and still didn't pass Design QA. Please take a look at those batches.
outcome.doneFaces: All expressions are drawn. Check the expression sheet — any you don't like can be redrawn.
outcome.doneOutfits: The wardrobe is complete. Check the Outfit page — any you don't like can be redrawn.
outcome.doneExtras: Expressions and wardrobe are done. Anything you don't like can be redrawn from the expression sheet or the Outfit page.

reason.AUTOPILOT_NEEDS_SCREEN: The front is cropped on screen and it waited too long. Open this character, then resume.
reason.AUTOPILOT_WAIT_TIMEOUT: Waited too long for AI to find the angles. Resume to try again.
reason.DRAW_USAGE_LIMIT: Your Codex usage limit has been reached. Resume once it resets.
reason.AUTOPILOT_STEP_LIMIT: This run drew a lot of times, so it paused for you to take a look.
reason.AUTOPILOT_REVIEW_FAILED: Design QA failed to finish twice, so autopilot paused. Open that batch to pick one yourself, or resume to ask QA again (nothing is redrawn).
reason.AUTOPILOT_FRONT_NEEDS_SPLIT: The main illustration you switched to hasn't been split into a front view yet. On the canvas, use it as the front or split the turnaround, then resume. Autopilot won't draw over it.

started: Autopilot started: AIDOL is drawing the full-body front first.
startedFaces: Autopilot started: AIDOL is drawing the expressions one at a time.
checking: Checking whether Codex can draw directly…

form.frontAlways: The front is always drawn first
form.variants: Images per step for Design QA to pick from
form.variantsHint: More images make a good one more likely, and use more of your plan.
form.expressionsChip: Also draw the expression sheet ({{count}} left)
form.expressionsHint: After the angles, each missing expression is drawn from the front view, starting with "Neutral" to set the framing.
form.facesOnly: No angles chosen: the chosen expressions or outfits are drawn from the current main illustration. The front isn't redrawn.
form.expressionsDone: Also draw the expression sheet (all drawn)
form.outfitsChip_one: Also draw the wardrobe ({{count}} outfit left)
form.outfitsChip_other: Also draw the wardrobe ({{count}} outfits left)
form.outfitsHint: At the end, each outfit without an illustration is drawn from the main illustration, changing only the clothes. It goes into that outfit's wardrobe; the main illustration stays the same.

notice: Keep AIDOL open on this character while it runs: the adopted front is cropped on screen. You can stop at any time.

log.adopted: Design QA picked {{view}} and adopted it
log.redraw: No {{view}} passed; redrawing with QA's notes
log.gaveUp: {{view}} still didn't pass after redraws; waiting for you
log.userPicked: You picked {{view}} yourself, so autopilot kept your choice
log.staleBatch: The main illustration changed, so {{view}} is redrawn from the new one
log.removed: {{view}} was removed from the expression sheet, so it was skipped
log.outfitRemoved: The outfit used for {{view}} was deleted, so that batch wasn't adopted; redrawing with an outfit that still exists
log.outfitSkipped: {{view}} was deleted or is now the main outfit, so it was skipped

redrawsFront: The current main illustration hasn't been split into a front view yet, so autopilot will first draw a full-body front from it and adopt that. The original stays in the gallery and you can switch back later.
introOutfits: AIDOL draws each outfit in the wardrobe that has no illustration yet with your Codex, from the main illustration (same face, hair and body, only the clothes change), and Design QA picks the best image from each batch and puts it in that outfit's wardrobe. Anything you don't like can be redrawn later on the Outfit page.
introExtras: AIDOL first draws the missing expressions from the main illustration with your Codex, then each outfit that has no illustration yet, and Design QA picks the best image from each batch and adopts it for you. Anything you don't like can be redrawn later.
startedOutfits: Autopilot started: AIDOL is drawing the wardrobe one outfit at a time.
startedExtras: Autopilot started: AIDOL is drawing the expressions first, then the wardrobe.
